title: m3we
body:
## m3we
Have you ever wanted to create your own Minecraft mod but don't want to create a bulky Java project? Maybe you want to create a portable project, one you can edit and test easily and quickly? ~~Or you've wanted to set up a modded server for your friends, but don't want to require a hefty zip file to send to them?~~(wip)

If that describes you, then m3we is the mod for you :) m3we is a modding tool that takes the complication out of your creating process. Using just JSON and Lua files, you can create *almost anything you can think of: custom blocks, custom items, ~~custom entities~~(wip), and all with complex Lua-driven behaviors.

m3we aims to make creating your own custom Minecraft content accessible to anyone. All you need to know is Lua scripting, and with the [extensive documentation](https://github.com/kyfex-uwu/m3we/wiki) you can create to your heart's desire.
